shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Subtle interactive emphasis on secondary buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6, #3b82f6); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; padding: 0.34rem 0.8rem; font: 600 0.8rem Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -4px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f8fafc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with a subtle surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 6px; color: #f8fafc; padding: 0.32rem 0.72rem; font: 500 0.8rem Outfit, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8b5cf6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark field with a violet focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 6px; color: #f8fafc; padding: 0.36rem 0.65rem; font: 400 0.82rem Outfit, sans-serif; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #8b5cf6; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15); outline: none; }

components.name: Flat Container
components.html:
Study materials

Continue where you left off.
components.css: .ds-container { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; } .ds-container h2 { color: #f8fafc; font: 600 1.4rem/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; } .ds-container p { color: #94a3b8; font: 400 0.95rem/1.5 Outfit, sans-serif; margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15); color: #a78bfa; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 0.75rem Outfit, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A compact workspace for managing study materials and assessments. Deep navy surfaces keep attention on the task, with violet and blue accents making actions and selection states easy to find.
keyCharacteristics: Calm dark surfaces with bright action cues.
Compact layouts that keep related study controls close.
Clear status and selection treatments for exam workflows.

rules.name: The Accent-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Use violet and blue to communicate actions, selection, and status; keep large reading areas on dark neutral surfaces.

dos: Do use violet and blue as purposeful action and status signals.
Do keep exam controls flexible and wrapping on smaller screens.
Do make focus, pending, and completion states explicit.
Do maintain readable text contrast on dark surfaces.
donts: Don't nest decorative cards inside other cards.
Don't communicate exam state through color alone.
Don't use secondary text for critical instructions or actions.
